title: Uninformed Choices in Perishables
authors: Karsten T. Hansen; Kanishka Misra; Robert Evan Sanders
eligible_reason: Structural choice model of consumer selection among expiration-date vintages of perishables (retail shelf states, waste counterfactuals). No difference-in-differences or event-study design.
design_notes: c3_choice_model_backend_functions.R and c4_run_choice_model_simulated_data.R estimate the vintage-choice model on simulated baskets and shelf states (simulationsimmary.Rmd summarizes Monte Carlo recovery).
data_files_note: readme.txt: 'Given our data are propitiatory, we cannot disclose the true data for this project. In this simulation we show how our model works with simulated data.'
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
